paragraphs: The 528i was part of the F10/F11 5 Series generation, produced from 2010 to 2017. It uses the N20 — BMW's 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, which replaced the naturally aspirated six-cylinder units in earlier models. The N20 was BMW's first mass-market turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine and delivers a strong blend of performance and efficiency. It was discontinued when the G30-generation 5 Series arrived in 2017, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 528i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The 528i uses the N20 engine across its entire F10/F11 production run. However, there were running changes during production — early N20 engines (pre-2015) have a different timing chain guide design that is more prone to wear than later revisions.
